prTitle: Add guest management functionality to existing bookings
head: 92f44dcea7ff19e9123a30c63c167a2938df5a55

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found via the commit history of addGuests.handler.ts (first commit baa9045af7, 'feat: ability to add guests via app.cal.com/bookings (#14740)'). PR headRefOid equals the benchmark head and the merged handler is byte-identical to the benchmark head. The repo calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy.

tps.bug: Guest email uniqueness is checked case-sensitively, so case variants of the same address are accepted as distinct guests (and slip past the lowercased blacklist).
tps.evidenciaOpus: apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:26-29 (new) checks uniqueness with new Set(emails), case-sensitively; addGuests.handler.ts:71-77 lowercases the blacklist but compares guest and attendee emails without normalizing, so case variants of the same address pass as distinct guests.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The newly added apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:26-29 compares raw strings with Set, and line 54 submits them unchanged, allowing case-variant duplicates. packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:70-78 also compares guests case-sensitively against attendees and lowercased blacklist entries. Lines 83-103 persist those unnormalized guests, making both duplicate attendees and case-based blacklist bypass possible.
